A young woman, dressed in a white oversized t-shirt, black athletic shorts, and white sneakers, stands poised on a manicured green lawn with patterned stone pavers. She holds a badminton racket in her right hand, her body slightly tensed in anticipation. In the middle ground, a man in a grey t-shirt and shorts stands near a colorful plastic playground structure, holding a thick red foam bat. A toddler in a white shirt wanders near a purple and yellow slide in the background. (2) The woman serves the shuttlecock with a controlled underhand swing, sending it high into the air toward the man. The man tracks the object with his eyes, shifts his weight, and swings the red bat with a full-body rotation, successfully making contact. The camera follows the high-arcing flight of the shuttlecock as it travels across the yard. The background includes a grey multi-story apartment building with visible air conditioning units and large windows. (3) The camera pans right, following the movement of the shuttlecock, eventually losing sight of the players as it focuses on the textured stone wall of the property. The man's voice is heard celebrating the successful hit. The overall atmosphere is casual and domestic, with clear, direct natural sunlight casting soft shadows on the lawn.
